content: Landenu mbandu ya meni, bwosu yisi landa meni-meni mbandu ya Kidisitu.
Mukhetu kafweti difidinga mutwa mu tangwa dya bisambu
Yilutsikisini: kikuma kya buna lwisi ngyubuka mu mambu moosu, mu kulandaka mikuku bwosu buna yíluhekilamya.
Buthwena, nzodi ni lwazayabwa: Kidisitu kenina pfumu wa yakala wosu, yakala kenina pfumu wa mukhetu, amana Nzambi kenina pfumu wa Kidisitu.
Ho ni, yakala mosi wubati lombila kondilo wubati bikula ku mutwa wakufidinga, kabati lewula Kidisitu wenina Pfumu wandi.
Kaasi mukhetu wosu wuna wubati lombila kondilo wubati bikula, konda kufidinga ku mutwa, yakala dyandi kabati lewula wenina pfumu wandi; yandi kenina hanga mukhetu mosi bakuludi tsuki
Ho ni mukhetu kadifidingiku kitambala ku mutwa, kadivuka kwandi tsuki! Kaasi yuka ni tsoni bwenina kwena mukhetu mu kudivuka tsuki kondilo mu kukululaza, bulungi kadifidinga mutwa
Yakala kafwaniku ni kadifidinga mutwa mukuma yandi kenina kifwanisu yi khembu ya Nzambi. Kaasi mukhetu, yandi, kenina khembu ya yakala.
Kikuma, ka yakala ku wáhangama mu lutu lwa mukhetu, kaasi mukhetu wáhangama mu lutu lwa yakala.
Amana ka yakala ku wahangama kikuma kya mukhetu, kaasi mukhetu wáhangama kikuma kya yakala
Yihana ni, kikuma kya banzyo, bulungi mukhetu kakala hana thandu ya mutwa yi kidimbu kimosi kya kipfumu.
Yihana ni, mwena Pfumu, mukhetu kalendaku zinga konda yakala, yakala phi kalendaku zinga konda mukhetu
Kikuma, bwosu buna katuka mukhetu kwena yakala, phila mosi phi yakala kisi butukila kwena mukhetu; amana byosu kwena Nzambi byisi tuka.
Zengenubwoku benu-benu: mboti bwenina kwena mukhetu mosi mu kulombila Nzambi konda kadifidinga mutwa?
Byabina meni bihangwa bibati lulonga ni tsoni bwenina kwena yakala mu kusisa tsuki za kaleyi,
Kinga bwena khembu kikuma kya mukhetu mu kukalazawu. Mukuma bámuheka tsuki za kaleyi hanga mvwela.
Kaasi ho ni mutu kafinda hika phaka kikuma kya dyambu dyadi, kazaya lwesi bwabu: keti Mabundu ma Nzambi, keti betu thweku yi kikalulu kyahika kya bisambu.
Madya ma Pfumu
Mu kutala mbi zina zilandini, pfwaniku yilutsikisa, mukuma malukutakanu menu meku kikuma kya mboti kuluta, kaasi kikuma kya mbi kuluta.
Theti, mbati yuka ni, ha lwisi kutakana mu Dibundu, henina yi ngyengu hana kati dya benu, -amana khwikidibwa ndambu.
Bulungi ni, ngyengu zakala hakati dya benu ndangu bana bisi kwamina ku kimeka bazayakana. -
Disongidila ni, tangwa lwisi kutakana benu, heku ni kikuma kya kudya madya ma Pfumu:
mukuma, mu tangwa dya kudya, kosu mutu kisi tsusila mu kuzangula madya ma yandi-meni lwesi, mu phila ni mosi yi pfinya kaasi mukwawu wuzedini.

Lweku yi nzu kikuma kya kudya yi kunwa? Kondilo lwisi lewula Dibundu dya Nzambi amana lwisi zola kubakwatisaka tsoni batu babana bakondi kima? Biki pfwani ni yiluzimbwala? Yilutsikisa? Loni, mu dyambu dina yilendaku lutsikisa!
Kikuma, mana yítambula meni kwena Pfumu mamana yiluheka: Pfumu Yesu, muna phipha yayina bámulambula, wábonga dipha
amana, kunima dya kuvutula matondu, wábukunadya amana wuzimbudini: «Lwalu lutu lwama, lwenina kikuma kya benu. Hangakenu bwabubu mu kutsungaminaka meni.»
Phila mosi phi yi bungu, kunima dya kudya wuzimbudini: «Bungu dyadi dyenina Bulunda bwa pha mu menga mama. Matangwa moosu mana lwanwikima, hangakenu bwabuna mu kutsungaminaka meni.»
Mukuma matangwa moosu mana lwisi dya benu dipha dyadi amana lwisi nwa bungu dyadi, lufwa lwa Pfumu lwisi samuna tii yi kuna kakwísila.
Yihakana ni, mutu wuna wisidya dipha dya Pfumu kondilo wisinwa bungu dya Pfumu konda kuditesa kahóla disumu ku lutu yi ku menga ma Pfumu.
Kosu mutu kaditala yandi-meni amana kadya nana dipha, kanwa phi bungu;
mukuma wuna wisi dya, wisi nwa phi konda kubakula kisongila kya lutu lwa Pfumu, pfundusu ya yandi-meni kabati nwa.
Kikuma kya bwabuna henina hakati dya benu yi bambefu balawu yi bakwa bifu bya mu lutu, amana balawu bamana fwa.
Wadi twaditesaka betu-betu, batúfundisaku hika.
Kaasi muna pfundusu meni zina, mwamuna Pfumu kisi tusungikila ndangu tubelaku mukanu hakimosi yi batu ba ha tsi.
Yihana ni, baphangi bama, ha lukutakanini benu yi benu kikuma kya kudya, yukanakenu benu yi benu.
Ho ni mutu wenina yi nzala kadya kwena yandi-meni, ndangu lukutakanaku kikuma kya pfundusu ya benu-benu. Mu mana matadidini byufu byahika, yiyídikama ha yikwísa.
